title: AI-Powered Smart Patient Triage System
summary: A machine-learning pipeline that classifies patient risk levels, recommends departments, and prioritizes triage using explainable models (SHAP, XGBoost, stacking ensembles) served via a FastAPI backend. The pipeline's first stage, generate_dataset.py, uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a Metadata object to learn feature correlations from a small seed set and generate 5,000 synthetic patient records for model training.
